lines.text: Paul tells wives to submit to their husbands and husbands to love their wives and not be harsh.
Children are told to obey their parents in everything, because this is pleasing to the Lord.
Slaves are told to obey their earthly masters with sincerity of heart, and they will receive a crown from the Lord as their reward.
Paul asks them to devote themselves to prayer, watchful and sorrowful, and to pray that God opens a door for the word.
Paul tells them to act wisely toward outsiders and let their speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt.
